argv: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -like '*agentos_node.client_cli*'} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine; $p | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -like '*AgentOS*'} | Select-Object TaskName,State,TaskPath | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
